About me

I am Talha Nazir, a BS E-Commerce student currently studying in the 5th semester at the University of the Punjab, Lahore. I am originally from Chichawatni, Sahiwal, and currently based in Lahore for my studies.

I am a simple, friendly, and easy-going person who enjoys meeting new people and building friendships. Although I am naturally introverted, I also enjoy spending time with friends and attending social gatherings when I feel comfortable.

I have a strong interest in digital designing and practical experience using Canva to create digital products and designs. I have also gained hands-on experience in online selling through Etsy, where I created and sold digital products.

Outside of studies and work, I enjoy travelling, watching movies and web series, and playing sports such as table tennis and snooker. I believe in continuously learning new skills, exploring new experiences, and improving myself over time.
